items.html: *After we have clarified the matter of AA, we shall now clarify the order of its ten Sefirot, and how they clothe Atik Yomin. We have already explained above that this is the reason it is called Atik Yomin, as its seven days clothe AA separately. This is their order: Keter de AA clothes Hesed de Atik, and Hochma to Gevura, and Bina to Tifferet.
